MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The microSD card fits my Raspberry Pi projects because it could provide useful additional storage, provided it is compatible.",
    "The powered USB hub fits my ongoing desk setup work: I use several peripherals, and individual switches would make their connections easier to manage."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The streaming sticks, Echo Dot and smart plug introduce activities I have not been pursuing; my recent purchases support maintaining my computer and accessories.",
    "The 24-port switch and 4TB SSD relate to networking and storage, but their capacity goes beyond any need I have identified.",
    "Another HDMI cable and a memory-card reader offer functions I already have, without a clear reason to replace or duplicate them."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My interest in electronics seems to have been extended too broadly to streaming and voice-controlled devices.",
    "My Ethernet and memory-card purchases seem to have been taken as reasons to suggest more ports or storage without considering the scale of my projects."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My purchases often serve practical tasks such as connecting peripherals, organizing my desk and maintaining equipment; a clear use matters more than a broad connection to electronics.",
    "What I already own matters: the card bundle is relevant, but its reader adds little because my recent card purchase included one.",
    "Compatibility and an actual capacity need matter before I choose storage; interest in an upgrade alone does not make a particular drive suitable."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations partly recognize my computer and Raspberry Pi interests, but miss the specific tasks, existing equipment and capacity needs that guide my choices."
}
